# CAFE
JUICE CAFE FOR MATHURA
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Shree Krishna Juice &amp; Fruit Cafe</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Karla:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #1F3A34;
    --ink-soft: #274943;
    --parchment: #FBF6EC;
    --parchment-deep: #F3E9D0;
    --oxblood: #D9652B;
    --oxblood-deep: #B84F1F;
    --brass: #8C9B4E;
    --brass-soft: rgba(140, 155, 78, 0.35);
    --text-dark: #23281F;
    --text-light: #F6F1E1;
    --container-w: 1180px;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-padding-top: 88px; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    color: var(--text-dark);
    background: var(--parchment);
    line-height: 1.65;
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0; }
  p { margin: 0; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  input, select, textarea { font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--brass);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  .skip-link {
    position: absolute;
    left: -9999px;
    top: 0;
    background: var(--brass);
    color: var(--ink);
    padding: 12px 20px;
    z-index: 2000;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .skip-link:focus { left: 16px; top: 16px; }

  .container {
    max-width: var(--container-w);
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 28px;
  }

  .btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 14px 30px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .btn-fill {
    background: var(--oxblood);
    color: var(--text-light);
  }
  .btn-fill:hover { background: var(--oxblood-deep); }
  .btn-outline-dark {
    border-color: var(--brass-soft);
    color: var(--text-light);
  }
  .btn-outline-dark:hover { border-color: var(--brass); background: rgba(140,155,78,0.14); }
  .btn-block { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background: var(--ink);
    z-index: 1000;
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  }
  header.scrolled { box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
  nav {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 20px 0;
    position: relative;
  }
  .logo {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    color: var(--text-light);
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  }
  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 36px;
  }
  .nav-links a {
    color: var(--text-light);
    font-size: 0.98rem;
    padding: 6px 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { border-color: var(--brass); }
  .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }

  .hamburger {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 5px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 8px;
  }
  .hamburger span {
    display: block;
    width: 26px;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--text-light);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
  }
  .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
  .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

  .mobile-menu {
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.3s ease;
  }
  .mobile-menu.open { max-height: 420px; }
  .mobile-menu ul { padding: 8px 0 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .mobile-menu a {
    color: var(--text-light);
    display: block;
    padding: 12px 4px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .mobile-menu .btn { margin-top: 12px; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .mobile-menu { transition: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--text-light);
    padding: 90px 0 100px;
  }
  .hero .container {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.6rem);
    color: var(--text-light);
    max-width: 11ch;
  }
  .hero-copy p {
    margin-top: 26px;
    font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.3rem);
    max-width: 34ch;
    color: var(--text-light);
    opacity: 0.9;
  }
  .hero-copy .btn { margin-top: 36px; }
  .hero-art { display: flex; justify-content: center; }

  .hero-copy h1, .hero-copy p, .hero-copy .btn {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(14px);
    animation: heroIn 0.7s ease forwards;
  }
  .hero-copy p { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
  .hero-copy .btn { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
  @keyframes heroIn { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .hero-copy h1, .hero-copy p, .hero-copy .btn { animation: none; opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Section shells ---------- */
  .section { padding: 100px 0; }
  .section-deep { background: var(--parchment-deep); }
  .section-dark { background: var(--ink); color: var(--text-light); }
  .section h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem); }

  /* ---------- About ---------- */
  .about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .about-visual {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    border: 1px solid var(--brass-soft);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(140,155,78,0.10) 0 2px, transparent 2px 14px),
      var(--parchment-deep);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 24px;
  }
  .about-visual span {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--text-dark);
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
  .about-text p { max-width: 52ch; margin-top: 18px; }
  .about-text p:first-of-type { margin-top: 24px; }

  /* ---------- Menu ---------- */
  .menu-groups {
    margin-top: 48px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0 72px;
  }
  .menu-group h3 {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--oxblood);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .menu-item {
    padding: 20px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--brass-soft);
  }
  .menu-group .menu-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .menu-item-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .menu-item-row .name { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.08rem; white-space: nowrap; }
  .menu-item-row .leader { flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--brass-soft); position: relative; top: -4px; }
  .menu-item-row .price { font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
  .menu-item .desc { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.92rem; opacity: 0.75; max-width: 44ch; }

  .menu-footnote { margin-top: 40px; font-size: 0.92rem; opacity: 0.7; max-width: 60ch; }

  /* ---------- Testimonials ---------- */
  .testimonial-feature { max-width: 680px; position: relative; }
  .quote-mark {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 5.5rem;
    color: var(--oxblood);
    opacity: 0.18;
    line-height: 1;
    position: absolute;
    top: -30px;
    left: -12px;
  }
  .testimonial-feature blockquote {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.4vw, 1.7rem);
    line-height: 1.45;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .testimonial-feature cite {
    display: block;
    font-style: normal;
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    opacity: 0.65;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }
  .testimonial-support {
    margin-top: 56px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 36px 48px;
  }
  .testimonial-support div { max-width: 300px; }
  .testimonial-support p { font-size: 0.98rem; }
  .testimonial-support cite { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.6; margin-top: 8px; }

  /* ---------- Visit ---------- */
  .visit-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 64px;
    align-items: start;
  }
  .hours-list { margin-top: 24px; }
  .hours-list li {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    max-width: 320px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(246,241,225,0.14);
    font-size: 0.98rem;
  }
  .visit-contact { margin-top: 28px; }
  .visit-contact p { margin-top: 6px; opacity: 0.85; }

  .map-box {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    background: var(--ink-soft);
    border: 1px solid var(--brass-soft);
    border-radius: 4px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* ---------- Order Ahead ---------- */
  .order-intro { max-width: 60ch; }
  .order-form {
    margin-top: 40px;
    max-width: 640px;
    display: grid;
    gap: 22px;
  }
  .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 22px; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .field label { font-size: 0.88rem; opacity: 0.75; }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--brass-soft);
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--parchment);
    color: var(--text-dark);
  }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 90px; }
  .order-form .btn { justify-self: start; }
  .order-success {
    display: none;
    margin-top: 40px;
    max-width: 640px;
    padding: 28px;
    border: 1px solid var(--brass-soft);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--parchment-deep);
  }
  .order-success.show { display: block; }
  .order-success h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer { background: var(--ink); color: var(--text-light); padding: 72px 0 28px; }
  .footer-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }
  .footer-brand p { margin-top: 12px; opacity: 0.75; max-width: 32ch; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .footer-col h4 { font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .footer-col ul { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .footer-col a, .footer-col span { font-size: 0.92rem; opacity: 0.8; }
  .footer-col a:hover { opacity: 1; }
  .social-row { display: flex; gap: 20px; margin-top: 18px; }
  .footer-bottom {
    margin-top: 56px;
    padding-top: 24px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(246,241,225,0.12);
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .hero .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-art { display: none; }
    .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .about-visual { aspect-ratio: 16/9; }
    .visit-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .menu-groups { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
    .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    .section { padding: 76px 0; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 860px) {
    .nav-links, .nav-right .btn { display: none; }
    .hamburger { display: flex; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 560px) {
    .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .testimonial-support { gap: 28px; }
  }

  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .brand img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:contain}
  .logo{font-size:1.15rem}
  .hero-copy h1{max-width:14ch;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.2vw,4rem)}
  .hero-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:36px}
  .hero-copy .hero-btns{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);animation:heroIn .7s ease .24s forwards}
  .hero-btns .btn{margin-top:0!important;opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;animation:none!important}
  .hero-art img{width:min(100%,300px);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35));transition:transform .3s ease}
  .hero-art img:hover{transform:scale(1.04) rotate(-1.5deg)}
  .about-visual{background:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center/cover no-repeat;padding:0}
  .menu-group{margin-bottom:28px}
  .menu-item{transition:transform .2s ease,background-color .2s ease}
  .menu-item:hover{transform:translateX(4px)}
  .menu-item:hover .name{color:var(--oxblood)}
  .btn-fill{transition:background-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease}.btn-fill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .visit-contact a{border-bottom:1px solid var(--brass-soft)}
  .visit-contact a:hover{border-color:var(--brass)}
  header{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}

  .mc-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3000;background:rgba(15,28,25,.88);overflow-y:auto;padding:24px 16px}
  .mc-overlay[hidden]{display:none}
  .mc-box{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text-light);border:1px solid var(--brass-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:32px 24px}
  .mc-close{position:absolute;top:10px;right:14px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-light);font-size:2rem;line-height:1;padding:6px 10px}
  .mc-title{text-align:center;font-size:2rem;color:var(--text-light)}
  .mc-sub{text-align:center;opacity:.75;margin:6px 0 24px}
  .mc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px}
  .mc-board{border:1px solid var(--brass-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:18px}
  .mc-board h3{color:#F2C14E;font-size:1.1rem;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid var(--brass-soft);padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .mc-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:7px 0}
  .mc-item b{color:#9be28b;white-space:nowrap}
  body.mc-open{overflow:hidden}
</style></head><body><a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

<main id="main">
<section class="hero"><div class="container">
<div class="hero-copy"><h1>Shree Krishna Juice &amp; Fruit Cafe</h1>
<p>Fresh fruit juices, shakes and fruit chaat — taaza, seedha aapke glass tak.</p>
<div class="hero-btns"><a class="btn btn-fill" href="#order">Order Now</a><a class="btn btn-outline-dark" href="#menuCard" data-open-menu>Menu</a><a class="btn btn-outline-dark" href="tel:+919460069162">Call 94600 69162</a></div></div>
<div class="hero-art"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Shree Krishna Ji Fruits &amp; Juices logo"></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="about"><div class="container about-grid">
<div class="about-visual" role="img" aria-label="Fresh juice bottles and fruit"></div>
<div class="about-text"><h2>Fresh Fruit, Every Single Day</h2>
<p>Shree Krishna Juice &amp; Fruit Cafe serves fresh fruit juices, creamy shakes and fruit chaat made from fruit picked for the day. Simple, tasty and honestly priced.</p>
<p>Come by for a quick glass or a full fruit plate — we keep the menu short and the fruit fresh.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section section-deep" id="menu"><div class="container"><h2>The Menu</h2>
<div class="menu-groups">
<div class="menu-group"><h3>Fresh juices</h3><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Orange Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹60</span></div><p class="desc">Fresh santra, pressed to order.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Mosambi Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹50</span></div><p class="desc">Light, sweet and refreshing.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Apple Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹80</span></div><p class="desc">Crisp seasonal apples.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Pineapple Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹70</span></div><p class="desc">Tangy and tropical.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Watermelon Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹50</span></div><p class="desc">Cool summer favourite.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Pomegranate Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹100</span></div><p class="desc">Fresh anar, rich and sweet.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Mixed Fruit Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹90</span></div><p class="desc">A blend of the day’s best fruit.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Sugarcane Juice</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹30</span></div><p class="desc">Ganne ka ras, ice-cold.</p></div></div>
<div class="menu-group"><h3>Shakes</h3><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Banana Shake</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹70</span></div><p class="desc">Thick, creamy, simple.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Mango Shake</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹80</span></div><p class="desc">Seasonal, when mangoes are best.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Chikoo Shake</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹80</span></div><p class="desc">Naturally sweet.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Apple Shake</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹80</span></div><p class="desc">Smooth and light.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Dry Fruit Shake</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹120</span></div><p class="desc">Loaded with nuts.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Cold Coffee</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹70</span></div><p class="desc">Chilled and creamy.</p></div><h3 style="margin-top:28px">Fruit chaat &amp; plates</h3><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Fruit Chaat</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹70</span></div><p class="desc">Masaledar, tangy and fresh.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Fruit Salad</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹100</span></div><p class="desc">With cream.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Fruit Plate</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹150</span></div><p class="desc">Seasonal fruit mix.</p></div><div class="menu-item"><div class="menu-item-row"><span class="name">Papaya Bowl</span><span class="leader"></span><span class="price">₹60</span></div><p class="desc">Fresh-cut papaya.</p></div></div>
</div>
<p class="menu-footnote">Fruit changes with the season — ask what’s freshest today. Prices may change.</p></div></section>
<section class="section" id="why"><div class="container"><h2>Why You’ll Love Us</h2>
<div class="testimonial-feature"><span class="quote-mark" aria-hidden="true">&#8220;</span>
<blockquote>Seedha fresh fruit se, aapke saamne — har glass mein pure taste.</blockquote><cite>— Shree Krishna Juice &amp; Fruit Cafe</cite></div>
<div class="testimonial-support"><div><p>Juices, shakes and fruit chaat — all made fresh.</p><cite>Wide menu</cite></div><div><p>Pocket-friendly prices, from ₹30 a glass.</p><cite>Honest pricing</cite></div><div><p>Order on WhatsApp and pick up when it suits you.</p><cite>Easy ordering</cite></div></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section section-dark" id="visit"><div class="container visit-grid">

<script>
var header=document.getElementById('siteHeader');
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){header.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>12)});
var hb=document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn'),mm=document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
hb.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=mm.classList.toggle('open');hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o?'true':'false')});
mm.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(l){l.addEventListener('click',function(){mm.classList.remove('open');hb.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')})});
var f=document.getElementById('orderForm'),ok=document.getElementById('orderSuccess');
f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();
var t='Namaste, I want to order:\n'+document.getElementById('oDetails').value+'\nName: '+document.getElementById('oName').value+'\nPhone: '+document.getElementById('oPhone').value+'\nPickup time: '+document.getElementById('oTime').value;
var u='https://wa.me/917500614312?text='+encodeURIComponent(t);var w=window.open(u,'_blank');if(!w){window.location.href=u;}
f.style.display='none';ok.classList.add('show')});

var mc=document.getElementById('menuCard');
function openMenu(e){if(e)e.preventDefault();mc.hidden=false;document.body.classList.add('mc-open');mc.scrollTop=0}
function closeMenu(){mc.hidden=true;document.body.classList.remove('mc-open')}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-menu]').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',openMenu)});
document.getElementById('mcClose').addEventListener('click',closeMenu);
mc.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===mc)closeMenu()});
mc.querySelectorAll('[data-close-menu]').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',closeMenu)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')closeMenu()});
</script></body></html>
